author: StarTalk
description:
Why is there matter in the universe at all? Neil deGrasse Tyson breaks down what we know about matter-antimatter asymmetry, how it brought about the universe today, and breaking discoveries at CERN. 

Timestamps: 
00:00 - Energy to Matter Conversion
02:05 - The Symmetry Broke
03:45 - The Particles Within Atoms
06:53 - CERN’s Particle asymmetry
10:03 - Antimatter Universe
